sloka: कुम्भकर्णादयश्चेमे सर्वे राक्षसपुङ्गवाः ।रक्तं निवसनं गृह्य प्रविष्टा गोमयह्रदे ।। ५.२७.३८।।।।
transliteration: kumbhakarṇādayaśceme sarve rākṣasapuṅgavāḥ ।raktaṁ nivasanaṁ gṛhya praviṣṭā gomayahrade ।। 5.27.38।।।।

translations.english: "Kumbhakarna and other demon leaders wearing red clothes entered into a pool of cow dung.
